subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the security and workflow owners approve this grouped set of 14 executable-action pin updates for credential-bearing, CodeQL, release, and repository-automation jobs?
rationale: The patch has no concrete line-level defect, but CI cannot prove that every new third-party action implementation is acceptable for jobs holding repository, registry, app, and OpenAI credentials; CODEOWNERS and the protected `security` label require explicit owner judgment.

options.title: Approve after exact-head gates
options.body: Rebase, let the full required workflow suite finish, and merge after secops confirms the sensitive upstream action ranges and immutable SHAs.

options.title: Split sensitive updates
options.body: Separate Codex, token-generation, CodeQL, and Docker credential-path actions from lower-risk setup and maintenance actions for narrower review and rollback.

options.title: Hold the batch
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until maintainers can independently validate the upstream changes or a smaller Dependabot update supersedes this batch.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head gates
recommendation.body: Rebase, let the full required workflow suite finish, and merge after secops confirms the sensitive upstream action ranges and immutable SHAs.

likelyOwner.reason: The workflow history shows broad ownership across the affected CI, docs-agent, Docker release, and action-version maintenance surfaces.
